examples.label: Ron Chester, W6AZ (2023)
examples.citation: In recognition of his support of PAARA activities for over thirty years, during which time he served twenty years as Treasurer making sure that not only the books were up to date but all the regulatory filings were promptly completed. As a pivotal part of the Field Day team for many years, he prepared a manuscript submission of our results to the ARRL. Before moving to Illinois, he was an active participant in PAARA helping to make PAARA amateur radio club, what it is today, "the friendliest club around". . .

examples.label: Jim Rice, K6AK (2022)
examples.citation: In recognition of his energy and enthusiastic support of PAARA activities and meetings for more than Twenty years, developing the raffle, including his favorite, the Dream to Reality Raffle, coming up with prizes every month and running more than 200 drawings, contributing to increased attendance at meetings at a time when the club was in decline, helping to bring it back to the robust organization it is today, serving on the Board as VP for several years, and participating in numerous Field Days..
